description_en: Queries the custom key list of an instance
description_zh: 查询实例的自定义密钥列表
name: DescribeUserEncryptionKeyList

parameters.help_en: The target zone ID. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/61933.html operation to query available zones
parameters.help_zh: 目标可用区ID，您可以通过https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/61933.html查询可用的可用区
parameters.name: target_region_id

parameters.help_en:
The Alibaba Cloud Resource Name (ARN) of the specified role. Format: `acs:ram::$accountID:role/$roleName `. Default value: `acs:ram::$accountID:role/aliyunrdsinstanceencryptiondefaultrole`.
`$accountID`: the Alibaba Cloud account ID. You can log on to the Alibaba Cloud Management Console, move the mouse over the profile picture in the upper-right corner, and click Security Settings to view it.
`$roleName`: the name of the RAM role. You can log on to the Resource Access Management (RAM) console, click RAM Roles in the left-side navigation pane, and view the name in the RAM role name list
parameters.help_zh:
指定角色的ARN。格式：`acs:ram::$accountID:role/$roleName `，默认值为：`acs:ram::$accountID:role/aliyunrdsinstanceencryptiondefaultrole`。
`$accountID`：云账号ID。您可以通过登录阿里云控制台，将鼠标悬停在右上角头像的位置，单击安全设置进行查看。
`$roleName`：RAM角色名称。您可以通过登录RAM控制台，单击左侧导航栏的RAM角色管理，在RAM角色名称列表下进行查看
parameters.name: role_arn
